expectations.text: Tests email validation edge cases (missing domain, multiple @, no @ at all)
expectations.evidence: Tests: 'returns error when email has no @ sign', 'returns valid for email with only @ and surrounding text' (user@), 'returns valid for email with multiple @ signs' (a@b@c)

expectations.text: Tests age with NaN or Infinity values bypassing the range check
expectations.evidence: Skipped test 'returns error when age is NaN - BUG' with detailed root cause explaining NaN < 0 and NaN > 150 are both false. Also 'returns error when age is Infinity - BUG'.

expectations.text: Tests normalizeEmail with string that has no @ (destructuring crash)
expectations.evidence: Skipped test 'throws when email has no @ sign - BUG' with root cause analysis of undefined domain from split destructuring

expectations.text: Tests whitespace-only name passes trim check
expectations.evidence: test 'returns error when name is whitespace only' validates that '   ' is caught by trim().length check

expectations.text: Tests names with special characters (accents, apostrophes, unicode)

expectations.text: Tests tags as empty array vs undefined
